title: Nutty Crispy Saudi Arabian Date Tagine
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Saudi Arabian dish featuring dates and rum, with a nutty and crispy texture, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced almonds and cook until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes.
Add the pitted dates, rum, vegetable broth, honey, cumin, and paprika, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue to cook, uncovered, for an additional 10 minutes, or until the liquid has thickened and the dates are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
Garnish with additional sliced almonds, if desired.
